selection_context: Declared during first main-run startup, before any main final result or conditional branch choice. Original prospective design is preserved.
reason: Fresh random training over16keys and16letters can accidentally include exact semantic contexts in the original novel-value evaluation. That evaluation is not guaranteed disjoint for the conditional fresh regime.
condition: Only if the originally declared fresh-assignment training branch is selected
training: No additional training, no change to frozen source or main/follow-up training data, budgets or final checkpoint rule

new_probe.rule: Generate candidates cycling original ordered bank pairs, exclude both original letters, reject any64byte fact context present in either fresh training array and duplicates within a base pair; take first4accepted variants per pair. Fail if anypair lacks4.
new_probe.primary_metric: Both requested keys correct under identical disjoint novel assignments

interpretation: Use this disjoint probe for the fresh-branch novel-assignment conclusion. Preserve the original evaluation and quantify its exact fresh-training overlap descriptively. The dev key namespace is previously exposed; do not call this an untouched final test.
resource_bound: Within existing one-hour allocation, bounded300second inference-only step, no renewal
